The '''Bryx Freedom Fighters''' were a [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdout]] in the [[Bryx sector/Legends|Bryx sector]] following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and fought against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] control over the [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. The Bryx Freedom Fighters later joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and were reorganized as the [[Bryx Sector Force]]. They were led by former [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Horn Ambigene/Legends|Horn Ambigene]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
